definitions.gloss: rate of decline; rate of fall
definitions.explanation: How far a figure has fallen, expressed as a percentage of its earlier value. Used of prices, share values, and land values.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下落率|げらくりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五|ご}→五：00697_go⟧⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧だ。
examples.english: This month's rate of decline is five percent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下落率|げらくりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{大|おお}きかった→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: The rate of decline in share prices was larger than expected.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地価|ちか}→地価：12130_chika⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{下落率|げらくりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{縮|ちぢ}まり→縮まる：18725_chijimaru⟧、⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{兆|きざ}し→兆し：06633_kizashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えて→見える：01165_mieru⟧きた。
examples.english: The rate of decline in rural land prices has narrowed year by year, and signs of recovery are appearing.

notes:
⟦{下落|げらく}→下落：11321_geraku⟧ (fall, drop) + ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (rate, ratio). Standard vocabulary in financial and economic news, normally quoted against the previous month or year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下落率|げらくりつ}: the rate of decline in share prices
- {下落率|げらくりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: to have a steep rate of decline
- {前年比|ぜんねんひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下落率|げらくりつ}: the year-on-year rate of decline

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上昇率|じょうしょうりつ}→上昇率：30143_joushouritsu⟧: rate of increase — the direct opposite
- ⟦{下落幅|げらくはば}→下落幅：30175_gerakuhaba⟧: extent of the fall — the absolute amount, not a percentage
